shortDescription: Kobayashi Pharmaceutical said it has received a preliminary, non-binding joint offer from NSSK and an affiliate of CVC Capital Partners to take the company private. According to Sina Finance, the company said no decision has been made yet.

title: Kobayashi Pharmaceutical Receives Preliminary Take-Private Offer
